Part 3 of SQL Interview Questions:

One of the most common #SQL interview questions — and surprisingly, one where many candidates slip up.

Try writing your query solution in comment.

I've asked this question in multiple mock interviews, and I’ve consistently seen avoidable mistakes — either due to misunderstanding the requirement or incorrect use of SQL functions.

📌 I’ve shared a detailed breakdown and multiple approaches in the solution video — pinned in the comments.

 Worth a watch if you're preparing for interviews or just want to sharpen your SQL fundamentals.
